The best time to visit Nepal is during the autumn (September to November) and spring (March to May) seasons. The skies are crystal clear, making it perfect for trekking and sightseeing!

For mountain trekking, Spring (March-May) offers blooming rhododendrons and warm weather. Autumn (Sept-Nov) offers the clearest views. Monsoon (June-August) is wet and not recommended for high treks, but great for lush valleys.
